name: ingest
description: Stage 1. Assigns the fact ids F1..Fn in the caller's order; returns {facts:[{id,text,sha256}], narrative, call_ref}. Call exactly once per matter, first. The returned call_ref (I1) is what later tools take as ingest_ref; you never copy facts into later calls.

facts.description: The caller's facts as plain strings, in the caller's order.

narrative.description: Optional narrative text; empty string when none.

name: select_contracts
description: Stage 2. Returns the contracts to screen as {contracts:[{contract_id,source_sections}], call_ref}. Pass contract_ids OR sections (the API does not allow a schema-level either/or; the driver refuses both or neither).

name: describe_contract
description: Stage 3. Returns the contract's elements {element_id, description, is_denial}, required_elements and defeaters, plus call_ref (D1...). Call once per selected contract.

name: judge_element
description: Stage 4. Judges ONE element of ONE contract on the ingested facts. You pass only the ingest call_ref and the element exactly as describe_contract listed it (same text, same is_denial); the driver supplies the facts and narrative. Returns the element result plus call_ref (J1, J2, ...). Keep the call_ref: assemble and decide take the J refs, never the result text.

element.description: The element description exactly as describe_contract listed it.

name: quote_check
description: Stage 5. Verifies the quote of one judge_element result against the ingested facts (the system computes the offsets). Required for EVERY judge_element result that returned a quote, before assemble. Returns the check plus call_ref (Q1, ...). A judge_element result with no quote needs no quote_check.

judge_ref.description: The call_ref of the judge_element result (J1...).

name: assemble
description: Stage 6. Assembles the contract's assertions and wire line from the judge_element results. Pass the J refs of EVERY element of the contract, in the contract's element order; the driver resolves them (you never copy result JSON). Refused while any returned quote has no quote_check. Returns the assertions and wire plus call_ref (A1, ...).

element_refs.description: The judge_element call_refs (J...), one per element, in the contract's element order.

name: lean_check
description: Stage 7. Checks the assembled wire with the pinned Lean score binary. Pass the assemble call_ref; the driver supplies the wire. Returns lean_outcome and attestation plus call_ref (L1, ...).

assemble_ref.description: The call_ref of the assemble result (A1...).

name: decide
description: Stage 8, ONCE per contract, last (a second decide for the same contract is refused). Pass the same J refs as assemble, the assemble ref and the lean_check ref; the driver resolves them. The result (outcome, reason, elements, attestation) IS the product answer: the driver takes it from this tool result by reference. It carries no call_ref. Your last chat message is display only.

element_refs.description: The judge_element call_refs (J...), exactly as given to assemble.

lean_ref.description: The call_ref of the lean_check result (L1...).
